messages:
jasdeep: noticing GPU attach backlog for night batch jobs in ap-southeast1. spike started around 03:10 UTC.
ryan: any obvious errors in attach-controller?
nina: paste from node ap-se-45:
```
2026-03-24T03:09:58Z janitor[pid=1987]: scrub window start range=[0x1e000-0x1efff]
2026-03-24T03:10:01Z compactor[pid=1999]: started compaction ledger=le-7810
2026-03-24T03:10:02Z storage[pid=1200]: rewrite-index id=0x1e7a tmp=idx.tmp -> rename
2026-03-24T03:10:03Z attach-controller[pid=4102]: validate-local-index node=ap-se-45 extent=0x1e7a err=NOREF
2026-03-24T03:10:04Z attach-controller[pid=4102]: attach-reject reason=index-mismatch
```
ryan: NOREF during attach -> index rewrite raced with validate.
carol: how many nodes?
jasdeep: initial scan: 5 nodes in ap-southeast1, 2 in us-east1 showing similar pattern; all had scrub + compactor overlap.
nina: these hosts are on janitor v2.3.0 with compact concurrency enabled. v2.3.1 canary disables parallel compacts.
ryan: mitigation: temporarily mark affected AZ as attach-avoid in routing, and increase scrub cooldown.
infra-bot: route override applied: prefer-region weight ap-southeast1=0 (propagation ~30s).
carol: quick fix: add a cheap re-verify in attach path: if validate fails -> refresh index file and retry once. reduces transient rejects.
jasdeep: i'll open a PR for the attach retry and schedule a k-roll to v2.3.1 after canary.
ryan: cost note: routing away causes extra egress for users in APAC, approx $0.15/hr for heavy jobs. logging the cost impact.
jasdeep: pending attach queue dropped 2.2k -> 600 after routing+canary. monitoring.
infra-bot: Incident logged INC-20260324-scrub-attach-race. Assigned: jasdeep/nina.
